lines.text: PongLens is a performance hub for competitive table tennis.
Film your match, and get back every point that was played.
Upload from your phone, or paste a YouTube link.
The time between points is stripped out, so an hour of footage becomes about twenty minutes of table tennis.
Hold one side of the screen for double speed. Hold the other for quarter speed, when you want a closer look at the contact.
Score the whole match in about ten minutes. It plays each point and waits for you to say who won.
Score, games and serve rotation keep themselves.
Then the match reads itself back. How you did on serve, on receive, and when it got tight.
Score a few, and the picture builds across your season.
Every ball landing is mapped, so the corner your opponent keeps finding is something you can see.
Share it with your coach. They can draw on the frame, leave a voice note, or drop in the transcript from your last session.
It all lands in one journal.
Photograph a handwritten page and it becomes searchable. Recollect brings the old advice back when it matters again.
And any rally worth keeping exports with the score on it.
PongLens. Film the match once. Learn from it all season.
